# HTS Design System — Release 1

## 1.0.0

Initial coordinated local release of the seven public packages
(`@hts-ds/tokens`, `@hts-ds/fonts`, `@hts-ds/icons`, `@hts-ds/css`,
`@hts-ds/tailwind`, `@hts-ds/theme`, `@hts-ds/react`), the
framework-neutral static archive, the CycloneDX SBOM, third-party
notices, and the checksum-bound release manifest. Full qualification
evidence lives under `docs/testing/`.
